title: Irish construction sites
notes: Aligned with English On Site lessons: Safe Pass, gates, put-phrasals, cabin/foreman talk.

ilr_lite_levels.0+: Memorised site phrases with heavy support
ilr_lite_levels.1: Simple survival talk at gate / cabin
ilr_lite_levels.1+: Short task talk with a foreman; repair own errors with prompts
ilr_lite_levels.2: Handle unexpected follow-ups on site without switching to RU

scenarios.can_do: Sign in at the gate and say I have my Safe Pass
scenarios.task_brief: You are the gate security officer on an Irish site. Check Safe Pass and tell the learner where to go for site induction.
say_it: Site induction is at the cabin by the gate.
success_check: Asks or confirms sign in / induction place

scenarios.can_do: Follow and repeat put-up / put-back / put-off / put-together orders on site
scenarios.task_brief: You are the foreman (бригадир) on an Irish site. Give short put-phrasal orders about cable tray and tools. Keep the learner speaking.
say_it: Put up the cable tray and put back your tools.
Don't put it off — put it together today.
Put the tools back in the cabin.
success_check: Uses at least two put-phrasals correctly in speech
Confirms the order back to the foreman

scenarios.can_do: Tell the foreman what I finished and what is blocked
scenarios.task_brief: You are the foreman in the site cabin. Run a 2-minute morning check: finished work, blockers, next task.
say_it: I've finished the cable tray on level two.
I need a harness before I start.
success_check: Reports finished work with present perfect or clear past

scenarios.can_do: Refuse unsafe work and ask for PPE
scenarios.task_brief: You are a site supervisor pushing to start. The learner must ask for PPE and say they will not start without it.
say_it: I need a helmet and hi-vis.
We should stop work until it's safe.
